data.name: Hotel Antaris Cintermex
data.address: Av Fundidora 500, Obrera, 64010 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
This polished hotel is an 8-minute walk from Loroventura, a large park with birds, wildlife and rides, and 3 km from the Macroplaza, a city square surrounded by museums. A metro station is 1 km away.
Warmly decorated rooms offer free Wi-Fi and cable TV, plus microwaves, minifridges and coffeemakers. Suites add lounges and flat-screens. Refined upgraded suites have dining areas and dressing rooms, plus extra bathrooms and flat-screens. Room service is offered.
Breakfast is free. There's a restaurant/bar, an outdoor pool, a hot tub and a fitness center. A parking lot with 24-hour security is available.
